title: rosa woodsii var. macounii
intro: Rosa woodsii var. macounii, commonly known as Western Wood's Rose or Wood's Rose, is a deciduous shrub native to the western United States and Canada. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Rosa woodsii var. macounii include its potential to act as an antiseptic, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
